body:
Adds `research/noisy-referee` (stdlib Python, 12 tests, deterministic experiments, white paper), plus README and portfolio page entries.

Results: raw proper scores against a noisy judge elicit `e0+γp` and shrink the Brier incentive by `γ²`; truthful-verifier rankings reverse at η*=0.25 (Brier); the backward-corrected surrogate is exactly unbiased for the true loss at a `1/γ` payment spread and (balanced case) `1/γ²` sample cost; misestimated rates give a closed-form affine bias with excess ≈ 0.164/m for m gold checks.
